run_thai_tokenizer: run the python script to tokenize Thai text from stdin using pythainlp word_tokenize
create_thai_tokenizer_script: create a script that reads Thai text from stdin and outputs space-separated tokens
test_thai_word_tokenize: test the python module by piping Thai sentences into segment_th.py via stdin
refactor_segment_th: refactor the segment_th script to accept input from a file argument instead of stdin
summarize_segment_th: summarize the python script that tokenizes Thai text line by line using pythainlp
